_doc: Thresholds of the coverage report (issue #88). They are reported, never blocking. Edit and commit; `--k` and `--state` override on the command line.

near_duplicates._doc: ADR 0050: word 3-grams with a Jaccard of at least 0.5 are a near duplicate (a warning; a wave adds none). An exact duplicate fails cli check unless every pair of its intentions is in allow_exact (reviewed twins: these two are the female and male lines of a friend, the same in English). An opening or closing of 3 words shared by more than max(10, 0.2% of the texts of at least 5 words) is over-used (a warning).
